## Record details

<a id="anthropic-ai-fluency-framework-foundations"></a>

### AI Fluency: Framework and Foundations

`anthropic-ai-fluency-framework-foundations` · Anthropic on Claude Academy (academy.claude.com) · [official page](https://academy.claude.com/courses/ai-fluency-framework-foundations) · status: active

**Subjects:** Generative AI, LLMs, prompting & agents, AI strategy, operating models & ROI  
**Type:** short-course · **Level:** introductory · **Audience:** Non-technical professionals and leaders who want to collaborate with AI effectively, efficiently, ethically and safely.

**Prerequisites**

- None stated by the provider

**Learning outcomes**

- Apply the 4D AI Fluency framework to human-AI collaboration
- Judge when and how to delegate work to AI
- Evaluate AI output critically and use AI responsibly

**Practical work**

- Exercises and reflection activities within lessons

**Assessment:** auto-graded-quizzes: One quiz.  
**Credential:** digital badge, issued by Anthropic (Claude Academy). Academic credit: not published. Renewal: not applicable

**Delivery:** self-paced-online; 14 lessons, 1 quiz, about 4 hours; study hours 4 h (provider estimate on Claude Academy page); access: Free; sign-in needed for quiz and badge; starts: Enrol any time  
**From Ireland:** available. Free online platform; no regional restriction seen. Live-session time zone: not applicable

**Price:** free; advertised Free; approx. EUR 0

**Additional costs**

- None identified

**Financial aid / discounts (verified)**

- None verified

**Learner rating:** Credible but unrated (rating not published)

**Quality evidence**

- Flagship non-technical course on Anthropic's official learning platform
- Built around an explicit competency framework (4D) with exercises and a quiz
